upgrades.name: Temporal Amplifier
upgrades.textTemplate: You gain Dilated Time {value} times faster

upgrades.name: Superluminal Amplifier
upgrades.textTemplate: You gain {value} times more Tachyon Particles

upgrades.name: Cosmically Duplicate
upgrades.description: Replicanti speed is multiplied based on Replicanti Galaxies
upgrades.requirement: Complete your first manual Eternity without using Replicanti Galaxies

upgrades.name: Innumerably Construct
upgrades.description: Infinity gain is boosted from Antimatter Galaxy count
upgrades.requirement: Complete your first Infinity with at most 1 Antimatter Galaxy

upgrades.name: Paradoxically Attain
upgrades.description: Tachyon Particle gain is boosted based on Achievement multiplier
upgrades.requirement: Manually Eternity without any automatic Achievements

upgrades.name: Linguistically Expand
upgrades.description: Gain another Glyph slot
upgrades.requirement:
Eternity for 1e4000 Eternity Points using
only a single Glyph which must be level 3+.

upgrades.name: Existentially Prolong
upgrades.description: Start every Reality with 100 Eternities (also applies to current Reality)
upgrades.requirement: Complete your first manual Eternity with at least 1e400 Infinity Points

upgrades.name: The Boundless Flow
upgrades.description: Every second, gain 10% of the Infinities you would normally gain by Infinitying

upgrades.name: The Knowing Existence
upgrades.description: Eternity Point multiplier based on Reality and Time Theorem count
upgrades.requirement: Eternity for 1e70 Eternity Points without completing Eternity Challenge 1

upgrades.name: The Telemechanical Process
upgrades.description: Improve Eternity Autobuyer and unlock autobuyers for Time Dimensions and ×5 EP
upgrades.requirement: Eternity for 1e4000 Eternity Points without Time Dim. 5-8

upgrades.name: The Eternal Flow
upgrades.description: Gain Eternities per second equal to your Reality count

upgrades.name: The Paradoxical Forever
upgrades.description: Boost Tachyon Particle gain based on ×5 Eternity Point multiplier
upgrades.requirement:
Have 10 B Eternity Points without purchasing
the ×5 Eternity Point upgrade

upgrades.name: Disparity of Rarity
upgrades.description: Improve the Glyph rarity formula
upgrades.requirementSource:
() => `Reality with ${formatInt(4)} Glyphs equipped of uncommon or better rarity
      (${formatInt(Glyphs.activeWithoutCompanion.countWhere(g => g && g.strength >= 1.5))} equipped)`

upgrades.name: Duplicity of Potency
upgrades.description: 50% chance to get an additional effect on Glyphs

upgrades.name: Measure of Forever
upgrades.description: Eternity count boosts Glyph level
upgrades.requirementSource:
() => `Reality with ${formatInt(4)} Glyphs equipped, each at level ${formatInt(10)} or higher
      (${formatInt(Glyphs.activeWithoutCompanion.countWhere(g => g && g.level >= 10))} equipped)`

upgrades.name: Scour to Empower
upgrades.description: You can sacrifice Glyphs for permanent bonuses (Shift + click)
upgrades.requirementSource:
() => `Have a total of ${formatInt(30)} or more Glyphs at once
      (You have ${formatInt(Glyphs.allGlyphs.countWhere(g => g.type !== "companion"))})`

upgrades.name: Parity of Singularity
upgrades.description: Unlock another Black Hole
upgrades.requirementSource:
() => `${formatInt(100)} days total play time after unlocking the Black Hole
      (Currently: ${Time.timeSinceBlackHole.toStringShort(false)})`

upgrades.name: Cosmic Conglomerate
upgrades.description: Remote Antimatter Galaxy scaling is moved to 100,000 galaxies
upgrades.requirementSource:
() => `${formatInt(Replicanti.galaxies.total + player.galaxies +
      player.dilation.totalTachyonGalaxies)}/${formatInt(2800)} total Galaxies from all types`

upgrades.name: Temporal Transcendence
upgrades.description: Time Dimension multiplier based on days spent in this Reality

upgrades.name: Replicative Rapidity
upgrades.description: Replicanti speed is boosted based on your fastest game-time Reality
upgrades.requirementSource:
() => `Reality in under ${formatInt(15)} minutes of game time
      (Fastest: ${Time.bestReality.toStringShort()})`

upgrades.name: Synthetic Symbolism
upgrades.description: Gain another Glyph slot
upgrades.requirement: Reality for 5,000 Reality Machines without equipped Glyphs

upgrades.name: Effortless Existence
upgrades.description: Unlock the Reality autobuyer and Automator command

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Elliptic Materiality
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Increase the Reality Machine cap by ×1e100

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Runic Assurance
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Delay Glyph Instability starting level by 200

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Suspicion of Interference
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Time Dimension power based on total antimatter

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Consequences of Illusions
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Gain free Dimboosts based on Imaginary rebuyable count
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Make a level 9,000 Glyph with a single Glyph level factor weight at
100

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Transience of Information
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Increase Imaginary Machine Cap based on Imaginary Upgrades purchased
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Reach 1.80e308 projected Reality Machines within
The Nameless Ones' Reality

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Recollection of Intrusion
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Raise all Dimension per-purchase multipliers to ^1.5
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement: Reach a tickspeed of 1e75.000 B / sec within Eternity Challenge 5

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Fabrication of Ideals
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Convert Antimatter Dimensions to Continuum and unlock Lai'tela, Celestial of Dimensions
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Reach 1e1.500 T antimatter without
ever having any 1st Infinity Dimensions

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Massless Momentum
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement: Destabilize Lai'tela's Reality in under 30 seconds twice

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Chiral Oscillation
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement: Automatically condense at least 20 Singularities at once

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Deterministic Radiation
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Reach 3,850,000 Tickspeed Continuum without ever having more than
8 Time Studies in this Reality

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Vacuum Acceleration
imaginaryUpgrades.description:
Unlock Autobuyers for repeatable Imaginary Upgrades and generate Imaginary Machines
10 times faster
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement: Have a Continuum increase of at least 100%

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Existential Elimination
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Annihilation multiplier gain is improved based on Imaginary Machines
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement: Reach 1e7.400 T antimatter with Continuum disabled for the entire Reality

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Total Termination
imaginaryUpgrades.description: All Glyph Sacrifice totals are increased to 1e100
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Reach 1e150.000 B antimatter in Effarig's Reality with
at least 4 Cursed Glyphs equipped

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Planar Purification
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Increase free Dimboost count based on Tesseract count
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Reach Glyph level 20,000 in Ra's Reality with
at most 0 Glyphs equipped

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Absolute Annulment
imaginaryUpgrades.description: Increase free Dimboost strength based on Singularity count
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Have 13,000 Antimatter Galaxies in Ra's Reality
with a fully inverted Black Hole

imaginaryUpgrades.name: Omnipresent Obliteration
imaginaryUpgrades.requirement:
Reach Reality in Lai'tela's Reality with all Dimensions disabled and
at least 4 empty Glyph slots
